answer: The oasis explorer reveals the whole merge tree. Splitting into 5 separate vaults needs a separate funded island account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the mirror binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 113 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
